item.title: One Piece Episode 1156 Preview: The Straw Hats Finally Arrive in Elbaph (Release Date & Trailer Details)
item.description: The wait is finally over. One Piece Episode 1156 officially marks the end of the anime’s unprecedented three-month hiatus, bringing the Straw Hat Pirates to the highly anticipated land of giants: Elbaph.
